chapter: Booker T. Washington Community Center Band
title: The mellophone year and quick rise to first trumpet
summary: Mrs. Allen bought four mellophones; he played one for a year using his alto mouthpiece, then went to trumpet and in about two years was first trumpet.

bands.name: Booker T. Washington Community Center Band

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: Could you -- did you get yourself a tone on it right away?
Oh, yeah. I didn't have no trouble with that, because I'd had the idea of it for two years on that alto horn, you know.
Yeah.

See, what we did was two years on the alto horn, but one year -- just about, not exactly, but one year I played the alto horn, and we were breaking them up so fast, and then we come in one day after about a year and she had four mellophones. See, there was four of us playing alto horn, and she had four new mellophones. Now, this looks like -- the mellophone looks like a French horn.
Yeah.
Only you don't put your hand up in it.
Oh, I see.
And the pitch is E-Flat, same as alto.
Oh, I see.
The French horn is like an F.
Yeah.
See, this is E-Flat, but it looked like a French horn and you play it, you know, with the valves on top
there, and you'd hold it by the bell. So she come up with four of those.
They've got a pretty sound, don't they?
Yeah. Yeah, they've got a very nice sound.
Yeah.
And then I played the mellophone for about a year.
Yeah.
And then after that -- well, I used the same mouthpiece I was using on the alto, see.
Oh.

And then they moved me up to the trumpet. Well, I had the idea then and my lip was pretty strong, so I did pretty good, and I guess in about two years I moved up to first trumpet. Not solo, but first.
No kidding. Well, that was fairly quick, wasn't it?
Yeah, I moved up right fast, you know.
Well, you must have had a good tone right away, I guess.
Yeah, I had a pretty good tone, and --
And power.
Yeah. Yeah. Well, that come from the mellophone, see.
